entities.name: Julián García Valverde
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Julián García Valverde is a Spanish politician who served as minister of health and consumer affairs from March 1991 to January 1992. Before it he served as the chairman of the Spanish Rail network, Renfe. He had to resign from his ministerial post due to the allegations about his illegal involvement in land speculations during his term at the Renfe.

entities.summary: Julián García Valverde is a Spanish politician who served as minister of health and consumer affairs from March 1991 to January 1992. Before it he served as the chairman of the Spanish Rail network, Renfe. He had to resign from his ministerial post due to the allegations about his illegal involvement in land speculations during his term at the Renfe.
